Extract HWSD v2.0 attributes (dominant component)

Source: R/hwsd_extract.R
hwsd_extract.Rd

Extract HWSD v2.0 attributes (dominant component)

Usage

hwsd_extract(
  coords = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  param = "ALL",
  layer = "D1",
  path = tempdir(),
  ws_path = file.path(tempdir(), "ws_db"),
  internal = TRUE,
  tiles_deg = Inf,
  cores = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  props = NULL,
  output = "wide"
)

Arguments

coords

A point c(lon, lat), matrix (2 cols), or data.frame with lon/lat.

bbox

A bbox c(lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max); sf bbox also accepted.

param

Character vector of property names; "ALL" selects all available attributes. For bbox queries, non-numeric columns are automatically dropped when param = "ALL".

layer

Soil layer code ("D1"-"D7"). For bbox, must be length 1.

path

Output path when writing raster (used if internal = FALSE).

ws_path

Path to HWSD index grid; will be downloaded if missing.

internal

If TRUE, return in-memory raster; if FALSE, write to path.

tiles_deg

Optional tiling size (degrees) for large bboxes; when finite and smaller than extent, tiles are processed and mosaicked.

cores

Number of cores for tiling (uses parallel::mclapply on non-Windows).

verbose

Show progress messages.

props

Optional aggregation spec (from hwsd_props()). If provided, hwsd_extract() will synthesize results using those rules (equivalent to hwsd_compose()). If a precision column is present, it will be used to round numeric outputs.

output

Output shape for point queries: "wide" or "long".

Value

Tibble with columns lon, lat, and one column per requested parameter (wide) or long table for point queries; terra::SpatRaster (or file path if internal=FALSE) for bbox queries.

Details

Dominant component selection follows: prefer SEQUENCE = 1 if present; within SEQUENCE = 1 choose the largest SHARE; if no SEQUENCE = 1 exists, choose the largest SHARE (ties break by smallest SEQUENCE when available). For share-weighted synthesis, use hwsd_compose().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Dominant component (default behavior)
pt <- hwsd_extract(
  coords = c(110, 40),
  param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "D:/data/HWSD2"
)

# Share-weighted synthesis using default rules
props <- hwsd_props()
pt_syn <- hwsd_compose(
  coords = c(110, 40),
  param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "D:/data/HWSD2",
  props = props
)
} # }
